description: Nothing to add: ecoinvent 3.10.1 ships the same elementary exchanges in all four of its system models. Compared release by release from each one's MasterData/ElementaryExchanges.xml -- cutoff 4,362, apos 4,362, consequential 4,362, EN15804 4,362 exchanges -- with the same uuids throughout and every shared record equal field for field, not merely in the fields the adapter keeps. This file exists so that a version nobody has checked and a version checked and found clean do not look alike: the empty list is the finding. Regenerate with tools/compare_ecoinvent_system_models.py. See #100.
